note: F-I18N-001 §3.11 locale layout matrix (locale.spec.ts). Controls on the matrix screens the touch-target ratchet (touch-target-allowlist.json) does not walk that are under touchTarget.min (64) today, at every width and in every locale. Never add a line: a new small control fails the matrix until it is at least 64 x 64. When a listed control is fixed, the matrix fails until its line is removed, so this list only shrinks. A repeat of a listed control is numbered (#2, #3) and needs its own line. Making the PinEntry close control 64 x 64 is an open item (F-I18N-001 §10).
